source.note: equip_awake*.json byte-identical across all Global runs since 2026-06-12 and identical in CN. The refine UI logic (incl. the reduce-weight bug) is identical in Global and CN.

pool_note: The 12-candidate pool is fixed by the artifact's EQUIP SLOT (pos 1-4). It is identical for Hefty/Nimble/Arcane and identical for Tier 1-4. The Awakened Tier only sets how many of the 12 you hold (num_attr = 1..4).

formulas.weight_start: every candidate stat of the slot starts at EQUIP_AWAKE_ATTR_WEIGHT = 1000
formulas.marginal: p_i = w_i * k / SUM(w)   where k = number of UNLOCKED awakened effects
formulas.min_floor: if p_i < EQUIP_AWAKE_REFRESH_MIN_PROB (0.01) the stat is dropped from the pool
formulas.max_lock: if p_i >= EQUIP_AWAKE_REFRESH_MAX_PROB (1) the stat is pinned, removed, k -= 1, loop again
formulas.guarantee_threshold_k_eq_1: W_target >= 89001         (all 11 rivals must fall under the 1% floor)

client_bug_item_reduce.code: store.detailResultAttrNodes.forEach((_, id) => id !== attrId && reduceWeights.set(id, reduceWeight));
client_bug_item_reduce.problem: detailResultAttrNodes is an Array, so the callback's 2nd arg is the array INDEX 0..11, not the attribute id. reduceWeights ends up keyed 0..11, which calcInner strips because those keys are not in attrIds. The `reduce` column of items 4101-4524 therefore never applies.
client_bug_item_reduce.affects: Global and CN, every build from 2026-06-18 to 2026-08-07.
client_bug_item_reduce.equips_unaffected: Equip materials build reduceWeights from affect_weight ids, so their negatives DO apply (live-verified against the in-game panel).
client_bug_item_reduce.status: client-side confirmed by code; server-side behaviour untested.

live_verification_20260807.setup: Tier-1 artifact in slot 4 (pool = pos 4), 1 unlocked Awakened Effect, 4x quality-13 Hefty/Water artifact (equip 130102) loaded as material

stone_prob_single_target.note: 12-stat pool, target boosted by n stones of one tier, nothing else loaded. `shipped` = what the game computes today (reduce dead). `designed` = if the reduce column were applied.

stones_to_pin.note: stones PER TARGET needed so that every listed target reaches 100% (p = 1). k = unlocked awakened effects at refine time; m = how many stats you pin.

equip_only_prob.note: n copies of the +2w family for the target, no stones, by artifact slot and k.

sampling_models.note: calcInner returns MARGINALS. How the server realises k draws from them is not in the client. Any stat the calculator pins at p=1 is deterministic under every scheme, so the `stones_to_pin` numbers are model-independent. Sub-100% numbers are scheme-dependent.
